Dialogs.Dialog: That’s right. You hear us, Doc?
Aaand everything set and ready to go.
Those are Streptococcus Sanguinis, right? Seeing them in this size is quite intimidating…
Understandable, but, still, they shouldn’t be aggressive.
Seems I can’t get across yet.
Maybe try going downwards, there should be some cell that you can absorb. To gain a charge ability, you know?
Don’t worry about the Eosinophil; the MHK suit will keep you safe.
I feel… lighter. Getting across should be a walk in the park.
Hey Doc, Luke speaking. There’s no news from the central.We are trying to remain calm, but it seems like it’s taking a toll on Theo.
He is being more unbearable than usual. Also, the patient won’t stop trembling, it seems like anesthesia is losing its effect. Hope you’re safe.
